role: singleton daemon supervision, event-triggered chain launch, schedule launch, and stalled run recovery

watchdog.loop: check pty-manager, scan runs, cleanup orphans, reconcile tasks

chain_event_watcher.singleton: per-namespace mkdir lock with stale-lock reclaim and trap cleanup; duplicate watchers must not accumulate (7816b0f)
chain_event_watcher.loop: blocking inotifywait/fswatch wait on the events dir (no busy poll; idle watcher is ~0% CPU), then scan events and chain config.event_triggers (7816b0f)
chain_event_watcher.interval: CHAIN_WATCHER_INTERVAL default 10 (fallback poll cadence when no fs-watch backend exists)

event_triggers.condition_policy: safe_trigger_condition hard-rejects command substitution, backticks, ; | &, [[ ]] breakout, process substitution, and newlines before evaluating the remaining simple comparison; rejected or malformed conditions do not match (fail-closed); empty condition always matches (2b65e43)

watchdog_recovery.stall_condition: running run has no alive session/monitor/grace and running or pending agents
watchdog_recovery.preferred_write: watchdog-stop-run from run-lib under shared run lock
watchdog_recovery.event: diagnostic run-stalled event, not canonical agent handoff

session_liveness.reap_scope: deny-list of terminal run states: only runs in completed/failed/stopped territory are reap-eligible; unknown or non-terminal statuses (pending, blocked, paused, future values) are spared (e289ea8)

invariants: do not treat stale age as dead if PTY session is live
do not kill live monitor sessions
watchdog diagnostic events do not use canonical agent handoff shape
watcher idempotency uses handled markers, not processed mutation
run-session reaping is deny-list based: unknown or non-terminal run status is never reaped (e289ea8)
spawned shells inherit sanitized env: BASH_FUNC_* stripped at the spawn layer (7816b0f)
